sources.title: AhiskaAI v0.1 Experimental Training Code - GitHub
sources.snippet: AhiskaAI v0.1 is an experimental training repository for lightweight LLaMA-based language models. This repository includes supervised fine-tuning and pre-training scripts designed for low-parameter models, with support for ChatML-formatted datasets, prompt masking, and optional Liger Kernel acceleration.
